en.title: Adjust Prices
en.description:
Execute the operations in order: 1 x v changes the price of item x to v; 2 v 0 raises every price below v to v. The original problem writes the second type of operation as 2 v v; because the last two fields duplicate each other, this site normalizes it to 2 v 0, and the second field v still denotes the global lower bound.

Semantics follow the original OAMaster problem. The input protocol and the limits marked "site supplement" were compiled by this site and do not mean that the original problem provides these limits.
en.input: n q (1≤n,q≤100000), the initial price array, then q lines of operations. Prices are in 1..10⁹, and point indices are 1-based.
en.explanation: See the accompanying editorial for the approach, proof of correctness, and complexity.
